scenes.heading: THE AI CODING AGENT *EVERYONE* IS TALKING ABOUT
scenes.sub: Claude Code · 7 channels covered it this week
scenes.say: Seven channels covered this tool this week. Eighty two thousand views. This is Claude Code, the AI coding agent that runs right in your terminal.

scenes.heading: Claude Code
scenes.say: It's Claude Code from Anthropic. Not a browser extension, not a chat window. It lives in your terminal, right where you code.

scenes.heading: HOW IT WORKS
scenes.say: Type a request. Claude Code reads your codebase, understands the context, and makes the change. It commits, pushes, and even opens PRs. You review, it iterates.

scenes.heading: 82,526 VIEWS THIS WEEK
scenes.say: Eighty two thousand views this week alone. Seven channels covering the same tool means the developer community has converged on it.

scenes.heading: INSTALL IN SECONDS
scenes.say: Install with npm. It works with any project, any language. No Docker required, no complex setup. Just run it where you code.

scenes.heading: THE HONEST CATCH
scenes.say: Claude Code is powerful, but it's still an AI. It will make mistakes. It will misunderstand your intent sometimes. You still need to review every change. But for the eighty percent case, it changes how you code.
Have you tried Claude Code yet? Comment CODING and follow for tools like this.
